## Editorial result

26 candidates considered: Cardiff 8, Bristol 10, Birmingham 8. Selected **4 Cardiff weekend choices + 3 weekday uses**, **4 Bristol weekend choices + 3 weekday uses**, and **5 Birmingham weekend choices + 2 weekday uses**. Some ongoing venues serve both windows and are counted only once as distinct ideas. Four additional Bristol leads and one Cardiff booking-dependent lead remain on hold. All selected visits are free-entry except the optional Blakesley visit; travel, parking and purchases can cost extra.

Age suggestions labelled **DoNext fit** are editorial, not invented organiser limits. Every outing assumes a responsible accompanying adult. Generic visits are explicitly ongoing, not newly announced workshops. No school absence is encouraged: weekday school-age picks suit after-school windows or home-educating families.

## Delivery and freshness rules

Only the Bristol free-estates campaign has inspected artwork in this batch. It is an original SVG/typographic layout using the exact existing city mark, rendered to PNG; no organiser photographs or AI-raster illustration. The source renderer and output are retained. It is supported by Metricool, **not** queued into the JPEG-only direct adapter. Other city artwork is direction only, not delivery-ready.

Friday drafts are held for rechecking on 18 September and are not scheduled now. Keep maximum one campaign per city/day, normally 4–5 distinct campaigns per rolling week where evidence supports it. Count matching Instagram/Facebook copies once. Prepared campaign ideas do not imply live posts. Recheck before promoting any ready entry; do not advance timestamps synthetically.

All subscriber email is unsent editorial copy. The repository has interest-registration forms, not a configured delivery service. Future authorised delivery requires consent segmentation and provider-rendered sender, unsubscribe and preferences details. No personal addresses, credentials or subscriber data saved here. City-home links do not imply these new picks are already in live catalogs.
